faqs.question: When will the ACTIV app be available?
faqs.answer: ACTIV is rolling out across major cities soon. Download the app on iOS or Android to check availability in your area and pre-register your account.

faqs.question: How does ACTIV ensure venue quality?
faqs.answer: Every single venue on ACTIV is physically reviewed and verified by our team before listing to ensure real photos, proper equipment, and accurate live availability.

faqs.question: What happens if I'm running late for a booking?
faqs.answer: You can view your booking details and directly contact the venue manager through the app to inform them of any minor schedule changes.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or get a refund on a booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, cancellations made within the permitted venue window are fully refunded back to your source account instantly.

faqs.question: Can I share my booking with friends?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can share booking confirmation links directly via WhatsApp or copy details to share with your group instantly.

faqs.question: How do I find only verified venues near me?
faqs.answer: All venues listed on ACTIV are pre-vetted. Use location permissions or search by your preferred area to see active spaces immediately.

faqs.question: What types of venues can partner with ACTIV?
faqs.answer: Turfs, badminton courts, pickleball arenas, fitness studios, yoga spaces, gyms, and sports complexes of all sizes.

faqs.question: What's the commission structure on ACTIV?
faqs.answer: We maintain transparent per-booking models with zero setup costs or hidden subscription overheads.

faqs.question: How long does the approval process take?
faqs.answer: Most venues go live within 24 hours following quick verification and slot configuration by our onboarding team.

faqs.question: Can I control my pricing and availability?
faqs.answer: Yes, you have full real-time control over slot pricing, peak hours, blackout dates, and court availability via your partner dashboard.

faqs.question: How do I receive payments for bookings?
faqs.answer: Payments are processed securely online and settled directly to your registered bank account on a scheduled cycle.

faqs.question: What support does ACTIV provide partners?
faqs.answer: Dedicated account management, technical assistance, marketing boost in local search results, and 24/7 operational support.

faqs.question: Which cities is ACTIV launching in?
faqs.answer: We are actively expanding across Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Delhi-NCR, Pune, and major tier-1 sports hubs.

faqs.question: How do I cancel or reschedule a booking?
faqs.answer: Navigate to your bookings tab in the app, select the active reservation, and tap modify or cancel according to venue policy.

faqs.question: What happens if a venue cancels on me?
faqs.answer: In rare cases of venue-side cancellations, you receive an immediate full refund plus priority re-booking options.

faqs.question: How do I reach the ACTIV team?
faqs.answer: You can reach us anytime at Support@activ.live or submit the direct contact form below for prompt assistance.
